_doc: The one shared file for movement and feel numbers (owner 2026-11-08). One section per system; each value says its unit in its key or note. Read through Tuning.of(section).

vex._note: Vex's feel (GunslingerKit, GunslingerUlt). E: how far the Palm Lance pulls the view out, from how far away the cursor is (m from her): a hair point-blank, a little at mid range, the archetype's whole view_zoom only when far; eased at zoom_ease per s, never snapped. R: the shot leaves the barrel at x_fire_s on her clip (the gameplay cast is still on the tap); the shake felt by those near the landing grows with what it hit.

clip_warp._note: WardenClips: a kit move's clip retimed with no rebake, per art name and kit move: [s into the move, s into the clip] knots.
